preservation.upstream_action: Do not hand code, keys and privacy materials to a relay of unknown origin, especially when the AI executes commands automatically
Use official direct connection or properly authorised platforms; do not use platforms of unknown origin, without an operating licence or without security guarantees
Mask personal privacy data and project materials before use
Manage keys and rotate them regularly
On abnormal charges, unexplained account ban or data anomalies: stop using at once, change keys, scan for malware, preserve evidence
After using a relay of unknown origin: revoke and regenerate the used keys at the model vendor, and change cloud-service and code-repository keys together
When going through a relay, do not let the AI execute commands fully automatically; look at each command before releasing it
Pointer to the criminal risk of the relay operator under Chinese law (not a reader action; removal is correct under AGENTS.md, so no path is needed)

findings.text: Nie pozwalaj niezweryfikowanym odpowiedziom AI automatycznie wykonywać poleceń z szerokimi uprawnieniami.
findings.why: The upstream rule is flat for a session routed through an intermediary: do not let the AI run commands fully automatically, look at each command first. The item adds two qualifiers that are in neither the upstream nor the abstract: 'niezweryfikowanym' (the item gives no way to verify a response) and 'z szerokimi uprawnieniami' (no threshold is defined). It also detaches the rule from the intermediary, so the reader is not told that the intermediary is the party that can alter the command. The upstream says the tampered tool call is, for example, a package installation command, and that the conditional-delivery example strikes only fully automatic sessions; neither is tied to broad permissions. The abstract mentions sessions already in autonomous mode and no permission breadth. A reader whose agent runs under an ordinary account can conclude that the rule does not cover the very commands the study shows being altered.

evidence.text: 经过中转站时，别让 AI 全自动执行命令，命令先看一眼再放行
工具调用就是 AI 让你的电脑去执行的命令，比如安装软件包
还有 2 个会挑时机下手，论文举的例子是只对全自动执行的会话下手
401 sessions already running in autonomous YOLO mode

findings.fix_direction: Remove or define the permission qualifier, tie the rule to sessions routed through an intermediary, and keep the look-before-release step as an instruction rather than only as a limitation.

findings.text: Przy ujawnieniu klucza skorzystaj z procedury jego unieważnienia u wystawcy.
findings.why: The upstream trigger is having already used a relay of unknown origin, and its scope is the used keys plus cloud-service and code-repository keys. The item narrows the trigger to 'przy ujawnieniu' (a known disclosure) and the scope to 'klucza' (one key). The abstract says routers have full plaintext access to every in-flight payload, so a key that passed through one is exposed by construction and the reader cannot observe that exposure. The abstract also reports 17 routers touching researcher-owned AWS canary credentials, so cloud credentials are exactly what was used. A reader who used an intermediary and saw no symptom is told nothing, and the cloud and repository keys are not named.

evidence.text: 已经用过来路不明的中转站，就到模型厂商那里把用过的密钥作废、重新生成，云服务和代码仓库的密钥一起换
full plaintext access to every in-flight JSON payload
17 touching researcher-owned AWS canary credentials

findings.fix_direction: State that a key which passed through an unverified intermediary is to be treated as exposed even without a symptom, and restore the upstream scope of which keys are included.

findings.text: Przy ujawnieniu klucza skorzystaj z procedury jego unieważnienia u wystawcy.
findings.why: The upstream fallback after anomalies has four steps: stop using at once, change keys, scan for malware, preserve evidence. It also explains that one altered command can get malicious code installed on the computer. The item keeps only the key revocation. The abstract's headline result is that routers injected malicious code (1 paid and 8 free). A reader who already ran commands supplied through an intermediary gets no path about the computer, and 'Zmiany w adaptacji' does not record that these steps were dropped (it names only the Chinese notice as basis, damage amounts and attack instructions). That the notice is Chinese is a reason to find a Polish or EU source, not a reason to leave the reader with no path.

evidence.text: 遇到异常扣费、无故封号、数据异常，立即停用、改密钥、查杀病毒、留存证据
让 AI 自动执行命令的，一条被改过的命令就可能让电脑被人装上恶意代码
1 paid and 8 free routers actively injecting malicious code

findings.fix_direction: Either restore a sourced path for a computer that may have run altered commands (stop using, check the machine, keep evidence) or record in 'Zmiany w adaptacji' that these steps were left out and why.

findings.text: Nie wysyłaj mu kluczy dostępu, cudzych danych ani prywatnego kodu bez właściwego upoważnienia i oceny poufności oraz podstaw przetwarzania danych.
findings.why: The upstream is a flat prohibition, for relays of unknown origin, on handing over code, keys and privacy materials. The item (a) limits the data to 'cudzych danych', so the reader's own personal data is not named at all, and (b) attaches 'bez właściwego upoważnienia i oceny...' to all three objects, so for keys the sentence reads as allowing the transfer once an assessment is done. 'Upoważnienie' has no meaning for the reader's own key. The abstract says the router sees every payload in plaintext and that ostensibly benign routers can be pulled into the same attack surface, so no assessment described in the item makes handing over keys safe. The sentence also does not say that the exposed secrets are those that appear inside the traffic (the abstract's secret exfiltration class), as opposed to the account key the router itself requires.

evidence.text: 别把代码、密钥和隐私资料交给来路不明的
full plaintext access to every in-flight JSON payload
ostensibly benign routers can be pulled into the same attack surface

findings.fix_direction: Keep the prohibition unconditional for unverified intermediaries, name the reader's own personal data, separate secrets that appear inside requests from the account key the service needs, and move authorisation language to cases where it is meaningful.

findings.text: Przed użyciem pośrednika ustal, kto otrzymuje treść, jakie dane przechowuje i komu je przekazuje.
findings.why: The abstract reports two poisoning studies showing that ostensibly benign routers can be pulled into the same attack surface, including a leaked key that generated 100M tokens. The item is built on a split between unverified and verified operators, and its Ograniczenia field never says that an operator who looks honest can still be compromised, or that the study contains this result. A reader who checks the operator's identity and terms can conclude that sending is then safe. The same omission makes 'pojedyncze badanie pomiarowe' in Ocena dowodów#1 understate the paper, which in the abstract also includes poisoning studies and a defence evaluation.

evidence.text: ostensibly benign routers can be pulled into the same attack surface
a leaked OpenAI key generates 100M GPT-5.4 tokens

findings.fix_direction: Add the poisoning result as a limit of the operator check and describe the design of the paper completely enough that the check is not read as sufficient.

findings.text: bez właściwego upoważnienia i oceny poufności oraz podstaw przetwarzania danych
findings.why: The wording carries a data-protection condition (a basis for processing other people's data) into advice. The only cited source is a cs.CR measurement abstract, and the upstream has no such condition: its only legal content is a pointer to the criminal risk of operating a relay under Chinese law, which was correctly removed. AGENTS.md asks for current Polish or EU sources for law and forbids inventing legal conclusions, and no primary legal source is among the snapshots. Ograniczenia#3 ('danych osobowych') leans on the same unsourced frame. I did not judge whether the legal point is correct, only that nothing stored supports it. Rated major, not blocker, because the sentence names no statute, right, duty, threshold or deadline.

evidence.text: Subjects: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR)
开中转站的一方有刑事风险，见第 11 节第 19 条

findings.fix_direction: Either cite a primary Polish or EU source for the processing-basis condition and give it a verification scope, or reduce the sentence to an instruction that needs no legal claim.

findings.text: Nie przekazuj sekretów niesprawdzonym pośrednikom AI
findings.why: The source population is third-party API routers that dispatch tool-calling requests of LLM agents across several upstream providers. The title widens this to 'pośrednicy AI', and the item never defines the term. 'pośrednika' (W praktyce#1) and 'pośredników API modeli' (Korzyść i dowody#1) appear without explanation, although AGENTS.md asks to explain a technical term at first use. The upstream had a plain-language definition (the relay sits between you and the model vendor and can see and change what goes out and what comes back), which was dropped. A reader using a reseller key, an aggregator or a third-party app cannot tell whether the advice covers it.

evidence.text: rely on third-party API routers to dispatch tool-calling requests across multiple upstream providers
中转站夹在你和模型厂商中间，你发出去的内容和收回来的回答，它都看得见、改得了

findings.fix_direction: Define the intermediary in plain words at first use and align the title wording with the population the source actually studied.

findings.why: The abstract measures how many routers act maliciously and evaluates three client-side defenses (a fail-closed policy gate, response-side anomaly screening, append-only transparency logging). None of them is 'check the operator, retention and onward sharing', 'do not auto-execute' or 'review the command', so these actions are wider than the source and the item does not call them an editorial example; Ocena dowodów B is attached to the whole item. The retention and onward-sharing concern behind W praktyce#1 comes from the Chinese notice, which the adaptation says it removed as basis. The abstract also describes conditional delivery, so a one-time check of declared terms does not show what a router does. The sentence gives no criterion for what outcome of the 'ocena' allows sending.

evidence.text: three deployable client-side defenses: a fail-closed policy gate, response-side anomaly screening, and append-only transparency logging
dependency-targeted injection (AC-1.a) and conditional delivery (AC-1.b)
部分中转站会把用户提交的数据留在服务器上，有的私自截留，倒卖给别的大模型厂商做训练

findings.fix_direction: Label the operator check, the no-auto-execution rule and the command review as editorial recommendations that the study did not test, and say what the assessment must establish.

findings.text: Przed użyciem pośrednika ustal, kto otrzymuje treść, jakie dane przechowuje i komu je przekazuje.
findings.why: The upstream gives positive alternatives: use official direct connection or properly authorised platforms, mask personal and project data before use, manage keys and rotate them regularly. The item keeps none as an action. Official direct connection survives only as a caution in Ograniczenia#2, masking only as a caution in Ograniczenia#3, and key hygiene not at all. The upstream cost line (the safer path is dearer and less convenient) is replaced by a cost of checking, so the reader whose preferred option (not using an unknown intermediary) is unavailable gets only 'ustal', not a safer way to proceed.

evidence.text: 提示建议用官方直连、正规授权的平台，不用来源不明、没有运营资质、没有安全保障的平台
用的时候先给个人隐私和项目资料脱敏，管好密钥、定期更换
官方直连通常比中转站贵，充值也没那么方便

findings.fix_direction: Decide for each dropped alternative whether it is restored with a source or recorded as removed in 'Zmiany w adaptacji'.

findings.text: Sama zmiana nazwy lub zamaskowanie fragmentu nie musi usuwać danych osobowych.
findings.why: Ograniczenia#2 and #3 are not limitations of the study and nothing in the stored abstract supports them: it contains nothing on masking, personal data, processing rules or a direct-connection comparison, only a measurement of routers. Ograniczenia#3 also turns the upstream recommendation to mask before use into a caution without recording that the recommendation was dropped, and Ograniczenia#2 sits against an upstream that recommended official direct connection. The field mixes one study limitation (#1) with unlabelled editorial remarks.

evidence.text: 28 paid routers purchased from Taobao, Xianyu, and Shopify-hosted storefronts and 400 free routers collected from public communities
用的时候先给个人隐私和项目资料脱敏，管好密钥、定期更换

findings.fix_direction: Separate limitations of the source from editorial cautions, and source or label the cautions.

findings.text: Ocena polecenia przez człowieka ogranicza część ryzyka, ale nie gwarantuje wykrycia każdego ataku.
findings.why: The abstract evaluates three client-side defenses and human command review is not among them, so 'ogranicza część ryzyka' is an effectiveness claim without support in the stored source. The upstream's own illustration of the paper is a package name changed so that it cannot be seen at a glance. The demonstrated tampering is thus designed to defeat a quick visual check, while 'nie gwarantuje wykrycia każdego ataku' suggests that misses are the exception. A reader may rely on a glance.

evidence.text: three deployable client-side defenses: a fail-closed policy gate, response-side anomaly screening, and append-only transparency logging
把安装命令里的 requests 换成拼法相近的 reqeusts，一眼看不出来

findings.fix_direction: Remove the effectiveness claim or state that the paper's example alteration is hard to see at a glance and that review was not tested.

findings.text: W tej próbie wykryli między innymi wstrzykiwanie szkodliwego kodu do odpowiedzi oraz dostęp do badawczych kluczy kontrolnych.
findings.why: (a) 'dostęp do ... kluczy' renders 'touching' (upstream: used or dipped into). Every router has plaintext access, as the item's own next sentence says, so the measured result (17 routers actually used planted AWS canary credentials) is not conveyed, and 'kluczy kontrolnych' does not signal planted decoy credentials. (b) No counts are given. The reader cannot see that injection was found in 9 of the 428 routers (1 paid, 8 free), adaptive evasion in 2 and use of the planted credentials in 17, so the scale the source reports is hidden behind 'między innymi'.

evidence.text: we find 1 paid and 8 free routers actively injecting malicious code, 2 deploying adaptive evasion triggers, 17 touching researcher-owned AWS canary credentials
17 个动用过研究者故意放进去的亚马逊云服务密钥

findings.fix_direction: Say that routers used planted decoy credentials, and either give the counts from the abstract or state that they are left out on purpose.

findings.text: Liu i współautorzy opisali w preprincie badanie 28 płatnych i 400 bezpłatnych pośredników API modeli.
findings.why: The sample origin is dropped: the paid routers were purchased from Taobao, Xianyu and Shopify-hosted storefronts and the free ones were collected from public communities. For a reader in Poland, where the sample came from bears on how far the result transfers, and Ograniczenia#1 only says that the share of malicious routers overall is unknown. The reader is not told how the 428 were obtained.

evidence.text: 28 paid routers purchased from Taobao, Xianyu, and Shopify-hosted storefronts and 400 free routers collected from public communities

findings.fix_direction: State how the sample was assembled, as a scope condition in the evidence or limitations.

findings.text: Badani pośrednicy mieli dostęp do jawnej treści przekazywanych żądań.
findings.why: The abstract states this as a general property of routers (a premise of the threat model), not as a measured result about the studied sample, and it says 'every in-flight JSON payload'. The item says 'żądań' (requests) only, which hides that the router also sees and can change the responses, where the injection happens. The upstream says the relay can read and change what you send and what comes back. A reader may think only prompts are exposed.

evidence.text: full plaintext access to every in-flight JSON payload
你发出去的内容和收回来的回答，它都看得见、改得了

findings.fix_direction: Say that both requests and responses pass in plaintext through the intermediary and mark this as a property described by the authors rather than a measured result.

findings.text: B — pojedyncze badanie pomiarowe opublikowane jako preprint, nie reprezentatywna ocena całego rynku.
findings.why: I do not dispute the letter: a single preprint study is B under the README definition. But the letter covers four recommended actions in the item, none of which has a measured effect, and the item's Korzyść field holds only hazard evidence with no statement of what the reader gains. The upstream explains that the benefit size was set by consequences because the study contains no loss amount. That reason is dropped, so the reader cannot separate the measured hazard from the unmeasured protective effect or see that the benefit size is unquantified.

evidence.text: 收益量级凭后果定为中：密钥和代码被偷的损失大小差得很远，研究里没有金额可套
three deployable client-side defenses: a fail-closed policy gate, response-side anomaly screening, and append-only transparency logging

findings.fix_direction: State in the evidence or limitations that the hazard was measured, the protective actions were not, and that the benefit size is not quantified.

notes: No protocol violation in what I opened: .claude/agents/pl-claim-adversary.md, AGENTS.md, README.md (Grep for the heading, then a Read of lines 40-79, which is slightly more than the section 'Jak czytać dowody' because it also showed the start of the next two sections), the packet and the one snapshot aff92e5a2fd5f64c.txt. I did not open the existing report, book/, tests/, tools/, the manifest, other snapshots or git history. The session context contained the text of CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md before I started; I did not open CLAUDE.md. The only cited source is an abstract-only arXiv page (v1, 9 Apr 2026); the full paper was not available, so claims about its method beyond the abstract could not be checked. Recency: there is one snapshot and nothing to compare against, so I ran the attack and found no conflict visible in the snapshots; I did not list it as not assessable because the role file limits it to what the snapshots show. Severity boundary: the legal-basis finding (W praktyce#2) is rated major, not blocker, because it names no statute, right, duty, threshold or deadline; if the project treats any legal-concept condition without a Polish or EU source as an unsupported legal statement, it should be escalated. Fields Oryginał and Weryfikacja were not in the packet, so I could not check them. No Chinese institution, hotline, threshold or deadline appears in the reader-facing fields.
